responsibility: Implements the default-channel wrapper for SHORTINT and SHORTCARD text I/O by delegating to ShortWholeIO with StdChans standard channels. It adds no parsing or formatting logic of its own and exists to expose the short whole-number subsystem through ISO default input/output conventions.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the SShortWholeIO pair: it contains the executable wrappers that call ShortWholeIO with StdChans.StdInChan/StdOutChan, whereas SShortWholeIO.def only publishes the procedure signatures and contracts.
